lzNodeTest.description: Configuration for the lz-node-test test runner, which runs each test file with node and node:test.
lzNodeTest.title: NodeTestRunnerOptions

testFiles.description: Glob patterns for the test files, relative to the working directory. Defaults to every .test.ts file.

nodeArgs.description: Arguments for node ahead of the test file, such as --enable-source-maps. Options that add a node:test reporter or its destination are left out, as the runner uses its own reporter. Defaults to none. A test file whose tests leave something open, such as a listening server, ends once its tests and root after hooks have finished: at once if a test failed, else 30 seconds later, as a timeout in a mutant run and an error in the dry run. A failed test waits too when --test-name-pattern, --test-skip-pattern or --test-only filters out a top-level test. Close what the tests open in an after hook, or pass --test-force-exit here, as NODE_OPTIONS does not allow it; under it node:test loses errors raised after a test ended.

maxMemoryMB.description: The memory in MB that each process of a mutant run may hold before the runner ends it and reports the mutant as timed out. Defaults to the most memory a process of the test file held in the dry run, times 1.5, plus 1024. A dry run in which a process holds more ends as an error.
